set.n: George Gehrlach's gold dug up under his North Cass Street house, Portage (found 1903)
src: Portage Daily Register, 17 Jun 1903, p. 4, 'Thousands of Dollars Unearthed / Relatives of George Gehrlach Request Official Search' (Newspapers.com 610974240)
Baraboo News Republic, 19 Jun 1903, p. 1, 'Find Buried Money' (Newspapers.com 867655895)
Beaver Dam Argus, 25 Jun 1903, p. 2; Stoughton Courier, 26 Jun 1903, p. 2 (reprints)
set.st: George Gehrlach, who had lived like the poorest people in a humble cottage on North Cass Street, Portage, died on Saturday evening 13 June 1903. His daughters, Mrs. Paulina Felgenheuer and Mrs. Rebecca Manthey, claimed $6,000-7,000 in notes and mortgages and said the widow had appropriated it, and demanded a warrant. On 16 June Justice Heidt and District Attorney Andrews made an official search and dug up $4,890 in gold under the residence; the wire copies put the money under the kitchen floor at $5,450 with two notes from the daughters. Over $6,000 in property was recovered in all, and a bitter estate fight followed. Recovered by the estate; urban lot, no house number printed.
